say:0:1623489001:1.text: The venue is unusually crowded today. You notice Bel keeping close to Olaya, speaking to her in a low voice the whole time, while Olaya looks uncomfortable.
say:0:1623489001:1.source_cn: 今天的会场格外拥挤，你注意到巴布一直在奥莱雅身边低声交...
say:0:1623489001:1.male: The venue is unusually crowded today. You notice Bel keeping close to Olaya, speaking to her in a low voice the whole time, while Olaya looks uncomfortable.
say:0:1623489001:1.female: The venue is unusually crowded today. You notice Bel keeping close to Olaya, speaking to her in a low voice the whole time, while Olaya looks uncomfortable.

say:2:1623489002:1.text: Only when the host steps onto the stage does the loud chatter across the plaza suddenly die down.
say:2:1623489002:1.source_cn: 直到主持人走上台，广场上喧闹的人声才骤然安静下来。

say:3:1623489003:1.text: Everyone, welcome! Today's seminar is officially starting!
say:3:1623489003:1.source_cn: 亲爱的同学们，今天的研讨会正式开始！

say:4:1623489004:1.text: We're honored to have our special guest with us today. She's not a reporter. She's the founder of a support group that has helped many students through dark times, and she has extensive experience dealing with mana anxiety. Please welcome Olaya!
say:4:1623489004:1.source_cn: 我们非常荣幸地邀请到今日的特邀嘉宾——她并非记者，而是...

say:7:1623489005:2.text: Olaya forces a smile as she walks onstage. A wave of loud applause breaks out.
say:7:1623489005:2.source_cn: 奥莱雅勉强微笑着走上台，台下响起一片热烈的掌声。

say:8:1623489006:1.text: I'm sure you all have a lot you want to ask, so let's skip the formalities and go straight to questions! Raise your hand and speak.
say:8:1623489006:1.source_cn: 相信各位心中已有许多疑问，那我们不必客套，直接进入提问...

say:10:1623489007:1.text: I'll go first! Be honest with us. Is magic messing us up? Should we stop using it?
say:10:1623489007:1.source_cn: 我先问！魔法真的在伤害我们吗？是不是该放弃魔法？

say:13:1623489009:1.text: Um... this "low-mana therapy" everyone's talking about—does it really help? How does it work?
say:13:1623489009:1.source_cn: 请问……低魔力疗法，真的能缓解魔法焦虑吗？能不能讲讲原理？

say:15:1623489010:1.text: Ever since my mana got damaged, I'm scared every time I cast. I'm terrified I'll lose control. What am I supposed to do?
say:15:1623489010:1.source_cn: 自从我魔力受损以来，我每次施法都害怕失控……我到底该怎么办？

say:17:1623489011:1.text: I've started to hate magic... How do I change that?
say:17:1623489011:1.source_cn: 我已经开始厌恶魔法了……我该怎么做才能改变这样的想法？

say:18:1623489012:2.text: One heavy question after another is thrown at Olaya. She falls into a long silence. The whole venue goes quiet.
say:18:1623489012:2.source_cn: 一个个沉重的问题接连抛向台上的奥莱雅，她陷入漫长的沉默...

say:20:1623489013:1.text: A lot of people around me are dealing with the same thing I am. Their mana's been damaged too, and ever since then they've been lost and helpless... Olaya, they came here today as well.
say:20:1623489013:1.source_cn: 我身边有不少同学，都像我这样，因为魔力受损而茫然和萎靡...

say:21:1623489014:1.source_cn: 你有办法帮我们的，对不对？

say:22:1623489015:2.text: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.
say:22:1623489015:2.source_cn: 这个问题像最后一根稻草，彻底压垮了奥莱雅。你察觉到，她...
say:22:1623489015:2.male: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.
say:22:1623489015:2.female: That question was basically the last straw for Olaya. You can see the confusion in her eyes, and her fingers curl up without her even noticing.

say:24:1623489016:1.text: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.
say:24:1623489016:1.source_cn: 她无助的目光在人群中慌乱地扫过，像在寻找一个锚点，最终...
say:24:1623489016:1.male: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.
say:24:1623489016:1.female: She scans the crowd, clearly a little shaken, like she's searching for something, then she just locks onto you.

say:26:1623489017:1.text: She takes a deep breath. Her voice shakes a little, but her words come out clear and serious.
say:26:1623489017:1.source_cn: 她深吸一口气，声音有些发颤，但却清晰而严肃。

say:29:1623489019:1.source_cn: 假的？什么意思？你在说什么？

say:30:1623489020:1.text: Bel's piece was made up. All of it. I never created some "low-mana therapy", and I never told anyone to hate magic. That's not me!
say:30:1623489020:1.source_cn: 巴布的那篇文章是假的，我从未开发过低魔力疗法，更没有引...

say:31:1623489021:1.text: The support group is real. We do help students with damaged mana. But there's only so much we can do... People aren't getting better the way the article claimed.
say:31:1623489021:1.source_cn: 互助团队的确是在帮助魔力受损的同学，但我们能做的事情很...

say:34:1623489022:1.text: The crowd erupts. Bel and a few reporters look suddenly alarmed.
say:34:1623489022:1.source_cn: 现场顿时一片哗然，巴布与几名记者脸上瞬间浮现慌乱之色。
